name: Multilinear Interpolation
definition: A generalization of trilinear interpolation to n dimensions, constructing an approximation via the tensor product of univariate linear interpolations across n dimensions within an n-dimensional hypercube defined by $2^n$ grid points at the vertices.
summary: Multilinear interpolation generalizes trilinear interpolation to n dimensions by computing a weighted sum of 2^n vertex values, though its exponential complexity limits practical use to low-dimensional spaces.
